keep_playing_why: In Game B I knew the goal in ten seconds, got a hit or a funny bit of feedback every few seconds, and a win handed me a new yacht or lance, so I wanted one more round even after losing. In Game A I spent most of my ten minutes lost on a ledge with no score, no progress bar and no quick win, and would have quit at about a minute.
better_made_why: B has voiced reactions, thunder, crunch sounds, music, a clear HUD, on-screen words for every outcome and a working loop of match, result, unlock and next rival. Its flaws are small: stretched pause buttons, clipped text on the VS screen, a missing space in the result text. A is prettier in its art and story, but the camera clips through walls, zooms onto the character's back or hides her completely, the objective text lags and flips back, and buttons only show up when standing on an unmarked spot.
furthest_A: Canopy Terrace: rang the bell, took Mara's staff, caught her gust, gave it to the seed wheel, caught a second gust, released it into the copper grille and rode the updraft up to the balcony ledge (second run, about 330 s). First run got stuck for about 190 s and I restarted. Never got past that ledge; objective text kept flipping back to 'Catch the seed wheel's gust past the gate'.
furthest_B: Beat Pip Tiller in the first match (score 1,950, unlocked The Bathtub yacht). Lost twice to Bosun Barnacle (best 400). In Endless Squall beat Doc Volta (score 2,100, streak 1, won the Copper Rod lance) then lost to Barnacle in the streak; best Endless score 2,100.
